newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P ASSIGNS BBB- TO TUNISIA'S 10 BLN YEN SAMURAI.
newsitem.headline: S&P ASSIGNS BBB- TO TUNISIA'S 10 BLN YEN SAMURAI.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Thursday it had assigned its BBB- long-term rating to the Central Bank of Tunisia's 10 billion yen 4.35 percent series 6 samurai bond due on August 15, 2017.
S&P said the outlook for the rating was stable.

It said the Tunisian government's commitment to fiscal and monetary prudence should underpin manageable public deficits, low inflation, and a stable dinar, and reinforce the impact of liberalisation on economic growth, productivity and external competitiveness.
The reforms should be further supported by Tunisia's free-trade agreement with the European Union ratified in 1996, S&P said.
